en.title: Vin Diesel Declares 'Fast Forever' Script the Best in Decades, Promises Tears
en.summary: Vin Diesel has shared his profound reaction to the script for the upcoming 'Fast & Furious' installment, 'Fast Forever,' calling it the best he's read in decades and confessing it left him in tears. The franchise's eleventh film, slated for a 2027 release, is reportedly penned by Michael Lesslie.
en.body:
The roar of engines and the promise of family are set to echo once more, as **Vin Diesel** has dropped a bombshell about the script for the next chapter in the *Fast & Furious* saga, currently titled **'Fast Forever'**. In a passionate Instagram post, the franchise's leading man declared that the script, penned by **Michael Lesslie**, is the finest he has encountered in his extensive career. His words, "I just read the 'Fast Forever' script by [Michael Lesslie]. It is the best script I have read in decades. I am still crying…" convey an emotional investment that goes beyond the usual blockbuster fare.

This declaration comes after a period of development that has seen the script undergo revisions, with Lesslie taking over from previous writers. **'Fast Forever'** is slated to be the eleventh mainline film in the *Fast & Furious* universe, and Diesel's endorsement suggests a narrative that aims to be both thrilling and deeply moving, potentially serving as a significant milestone or even a grand conclusion to the long-running series. The franchise, which began with street racing and evolved into globe-trotting espionage, has always prided itself on its evolving themes of family, loyalty, and redemption, and Diesel’s reaction hints that this installment will lean heavily into the emotional core that has captivated fans for over two decades.

## A Script That Moves the Star

For a franchise often celebrated for its gravity-defying stunts and over-the-top action sequences, Diesel’s profound emotional response to the **'Fast Forever'** script is a compelling indicator of the story's intended impact. The very idea that a script could elicit tears from a seasoned action star like Diesel suggests a narrative rich with character development, poignant moments, and perhaps a farewell that will resonate with the dedicated fanbase. This level of personal connection from the star himself amplifies the anticipation for a film that promises to be more than just another high-speed chase; it aims to be an experience that touches the heart.

> "I just read the 'Fast Forever' script by [Michael Lesslie]. It is the best script I have read in decades. I am still crying…" — **Vin Diesel**

## What This Means for the Fast Family

Fans of the **Fast & Furious** franchise have long held a deep affection for the characters and the overarching themes of family that bind them together. **Vin Diesel's** fervent praise for the **'Fast Forever'** script signals that the emotional stakes will be incredibly high. This isn't just about cars and explosions; it's about the culmination of a journey that has spanned more than twenty years and introduced us to a diverse cast of characters who have become like family to the audience. The promise of a script that brings the star to tears suggests a narrative that will likely explore profound themes, perhaps offering closure, sacrifice, or moments of intense personal growth for the characters we've come to know and love. The community is buzzing with speculation about what this emotional depth might entail for the future of **Dom Toretto** and his crew.

## What's Next

With **Vin Diesel's** glowing review, **'Fast Forever'** is one step closer to production. While the film has experienced delays, the current script seems to have galvanized the star. Fans can anticipate further updates on casting, production timelines, and potential plot details as the film gears up for its planned 2027 release.
